title: Specs: update all docs from 0200::/8 to 0200::/7 Yggdrasil compat
description:
Update all spec documents to reflect real Yggdrasil addressing:
- 01-architecture.md
- 03-adaptation.md (SCHC rules may need update)
- 04-network.md (fix SHA-256 -> remove, use Yggdrasil algorithm description)
- 05-routing.md
- 06-security.md

Change /8 to /7 everywhere. Remove SHA-512 derivation description, replace with Yggdrasil AddrForKey reference. Ensure SCHC rules accept both 02xx and 03xx first bytes.
